review_method: Sequential source-first semantic review across the exact 29 dimensions. Null per-record tiṇai and speaker metadata remain reviewed-empty. Printed division headings remain navigation/context only and are not promoted into missing tiṇai metadata.

literary_domain.note: Kalittokai is treated as Akam work context; this is not inferred from the individual body or printed division.

tinai.note: The canonical record has no printed per-record tiṇai value; the printed division heading is not promoted to tiṇai metadata.

speaker.note: The canonical record has no printed speaker value; none is reconstructed.

poet.note: Any printed division-level poet attribution is retained as an unresolved source mention; no historical identity is externally assigned.

flora.note: Exact கொன்றை garland wording retained without modern botanical identification.

fauna.note: Exact வண்டு and உழுவை animal wording retained without modern zoological identification.

people_social_roles.note: Exact அந்தணர், addressed deity-form and அரிவை wording retained without historical identity reconstruction.

relationships.note: The repeated female companion/guardian participation in the dance is retained as poem-level relationship evidence.

clothing_ornaments_adornment.note: Exact ash, garland and இழை/adornment wording retained without material reconstruction.

material_culture_everyday_objects.note: Exact பறை and காபாலம் object wording retained without archaeological expansion.

weapons_warfare.note: Exact destroyed-fort, war, battle and killing wording retained without reconstructing a historical event.

communities_social_groups.note: அந்தணர் is retained as a source group expression without social generalization.

family_gender_kinship.note: Exact gendered woman/arிவை wording retained without social generalization.

religion_ritual.note: The invocation, sacred lore, deity descriptions, ash, skull and ritual dances are retained without doctrinal expansion.

death_mourning_memory.note: Exact killed-animal skin and skull wording retained without reconstructing a death event.

arts_music_performance.note: Exact drum, dance, பாணி, தூக்கு and சீர் performance wording retained without assigning an external performance context.

knowledge_technology.note: Exact அருமறை teaching wording retained without expanding its intellectual tradition.

values_ethical_concepts.note: Exact ஆணம் இல் பொருள் evaluative wording retained without philosophical expansion.

body_health.note: Exact throat, hands, waist, shoulder, hair, head and breast wording retained without medical modernization.
